notes.title: ANDERSON OUT IN EARLY ACCESS
notes.content:
ANDERSON OUT IN EARLY ACCESS

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37893735/2f071116860cb2b4135a4f551fce28775bc7f960.png

From the entire team here at AJRPG, we are incredibly excited to announce that after 2 years of development our debut Virtual Reality game, ANDERSON, is out now in Early Access!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37893735/43bccc1b8793cec2347e2a1e2d59299f66816514.jpg

What is ANDERSON?

ANDERSON is a mystery game set on a island research facility. As you play you'll solve puzzles, explore the environment, learn the secrets of the island, and ultimately escape. Please know that ANDERSON can only be played on PC, but works with all major PCVR headsets.

Purchase ANDERSON Now!

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.2
notes.content:
Okay Goodie! 


This patch focuses on completely eliminating the possibility of things falling through the floor as well as preventing players from putting their head through surfaces and potentially  spoiling  certain parts of the game for themselves.

As always please feel free to send any bugs, errors, or feedback to: support@ajrpg.com

 Hotfix 1.0.2 Patch Notes	

    Added re-spawning to all intractable objects
    Added buffer behind walls/floor to prevent seeing through them
    Added pause menu for Return to Main Menu or Quit Application
    Added new logo to main menu
    Fixed double music bug after completing the game
    Various bugfixes

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.1
notes.content:
Okay Goodie! 

Here is a small hotfix to address the issue with some items falling through the floor. If an item does fall through it will now respawn at it's last location. There's also a few other fixes. 

Also, those playing using Microsoft Mixed-Reality, we haven't implemented support for this just yet but are working on a patch to include it. Until then you may encounter some game breaking bugs when playing with this mode.

As always please feel free to send any bugs, errors, or feedback to: support@ajrpg.com

 Hotfix 1.01 Patch Notes 


    Raised floor level slightly to account for objects being out of reach
    Added respawning of objects that clip through the floor
    Adjusted locker door opening/closing
